findings.title: The test can pass before the reader thread reports failures
findings.body: The test sets `deletedAll` and immediately asserts the exception list without joining the reader thread. The reader may still be in an in-flight request and add an exception after this assertion, so the test can pass despite reproducing the NPE. Join the reader thread before checking the collected exceptions.
